verdict.rationale: Notte documents Functions, which are serverless deployments of browser automations that it says you can "invoke and schedule anywhere." That is a first-party scheduling claim, but it is a single marketing-level line, and the Functions doc excerpt is truncated. It is unclear whether Notte offers its own recurring scheduler or only callable endpoints for an external scheduler. missing for 10: explicit recurring/cron schedule configuration, documentation of schedule management (create/list/pause), workflow-level scheduling details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Serverless automations you can invoke and schedule anywhere.
Functions are serverless deployments of your browser automations
